title: LIT-RAGBench: Benchmarking Generator Capabilities of Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Koki Itai; Shunichi Hasegawa; Yuta Yamamoto; Gouki Minegishi; Masaki Otsuki
why_relevant: Introduces a generator benchmark covering abstention when evidence is missing, alongside integration, reasoning, logic, and table understanding—relevant for evaluation of RAG robustness and abstention behavior.
why_not_or_caveat: Small Japanese-origin dataset (114 questions); focuses on generator capabilities broadly rather than centrally on noise/conflict/adversarial robustness.
